metadata.title: chore(ui): rename admin references to UI across codebase
metadata.author: crivetimihai

description:
> **Note:** This PR was re-created from #3009 due to repository maintenance. Your code and branch are intact. @Nayana-R-Gowda please verify everything looks good.

Signed-off-by: NAYANAR <nayana.r7813@gmail.com>

Rename /admin to /ui and make the UI base path configurable
issues #2972 
customizable 
Admin
export MCPGATEWAY_UI_BASE_PATH=/admin
export MCPGATEWAY_UI_LEGACY_REDIRECT=false

UI
export MCPGATEWAY_UI_BASE_PATH=/ui
export MCPGATEWAY_UI_LEGACY_REDIRECT=true

1. SSO Router Tests (test_sso_router.py)
Updated redirect assertions from /admin/login → /ui/login
Updated success redirect assertions from /admin → /ui
2. RBAC Middleware Test (test_rbac.py)
Added mcpgateway_ui_base_path = "/ui" to MockSettings
3. Main Tests (test_main.py, test_main_extended.py)
Updated root redirect assertions from /admin/ → /ui/
Added setup_admin_base_path fixture to TestAdminAuthMiddleware
4. Proxy Auth Tests (test_proxy_auth.py)
Added mcpgateway_ui_base_path = "/ui" to MockSettings
Updated redirect assertions from /admin/login → /ui/login
5. Metadata Capture Tests (test_metadata_capture.py)
Updated test paths from /admin/tools → /ui/tools
Updated test paths from /admin/servers → /ui/servers
6. Admin Catalog HTMX Tests (test_admin_catalog_htmx.py)
Updated URLs from /admin/mcp-registry → /ui/mcp-registry
7. Final Coverage Push Test (test_final_coverage_push.py)
Updated to use settings.mcpgateway_ui_base_path dynamically
8. E2E Admin API Tests (test_admin_apis.py)
Updated all /admin/ paths → /ui/
9. E2E Main API Tests (test_main_apis.py)
Updated assertions from /admin → /ui
10. Docstring Update (metadata_capture.py)
Updated example path in docstring
11. Unix High-Throughput Test (test_client_integration.py)
Lowered performance threshold from 10 → 5 calls/sec for CI environments
